raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary
- Prefer `AiterPreshuffledBlockScaleFp8ScaledMMKernel` for ROCm FP8 blockscale linears when AITER reports a tuned B-preshuffle kernel for `(N, K)`.
- Shuffle weights once at load with `layout=(16, 16)` and call `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle`. Activation scales are K-major at apply, because ROCm `group_fp8_quant` still emits row-major scales. e8m0 weight scales are widened to fp32 at load.
- `is_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned` probes several M values (including prefill and M=3307), not M=1 only. A missing AITER #5141 config is treated as untuned, so the existing blockscale kernel stays the fallback.
- Split-K added in AITER #5141 stays inside that op. The tuned kernel name selects it. This PR does not pass a split-K argument.
- Branch includes current `vllm-project/vllm` main (`5c975563`). The gfx1250 Triton preshuffle path already on main is unchanged and remains on `AiterFp8BlockScaledMMKernel`.

Depends on AITER exporting `gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle` ([ROCm/aiter#5141](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/5141), head `61b717e`).

## Test plan
- [x] On gfx942, load an FP8 blockscale model (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B-FP8, TP8) and confirm selected kernel is `AiterPreshuffledBlockScaleFp8ScaledMMKernel` for QKV / gate+up / down / o-proj.
- [x] Isolated GEMM: K-major activation scales match CK; row-major scales must not be used.
- [x] Chat / greedy decode remains coherent vs the existing `AiterFp8BlockScaledMMKernel` path.
- [x] Throughput smoke: ISL=1024, OSL=1024, TP8. After AITER small-M FlyDSL CSV, CUDA-graph M (e.g. 120) hits a tuned row (no `not found tuned config`).
- [ ] Re-check the same gfx942 load against AITER #5141 head `61b717e` after this merge with main. The call contract is unchanged, so this is a regression check, not a new kernel.

@@ -3565,6 +3565,47 @@ def gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle(
             A, B, As, Bs, output_dtype
         )
 
+    @staticmethod
+    @functools.cache
+    def is_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned(n: int, k: int) -> bool:
+        # AITER #5141 keys this CSV by (gfx, cu_num, M, N, K). get_CKGEMM_config
+        # fills gfx and cu_num from the current device. One shuffled weight is
+        # used for every M, so any tuned row for this (N, K) selects the path.
+        # Split-K is part of the kernel name inside AITER, not a vLLM argument.
+        try:
+            from aiter.jit.core import AITER_CONFIGS
+            from aiter.ops.gemm_op_a8w8 import get_CKGEMM_config
+
+            config_file = (
+                AITER_CONFIGS.AITER_CONFIG_GEMM_A8W8_BLOCKSCALE_BPRESHUFFLE_FILE
+            )
+        except (AttributeError, ImportError, OSError):
+            return False
+        sample_m = (
+            32768,
+            8192,
+            4096,
+            3307,
+            2048,
+            1024,
+            512,
+            256,
+            128,
+            64,
+            32,
+            16,
+            8,
+            4,
+            2,
+            1,
+        )
+        try:
+            return any(
+                get_CKGEMM_config(m, n, k, config_file) is not None for m in sample_m
+            )
+        except (AttributeError, ImportError, OSError, KeyError, ValueError):
+            return False

         return gemm_a8w8_blockscale_op(
             A, B, As, Bs, list(self.weight_group_shape), output_dtype=out_dtype
         )
+
+
+class AiterPreshuffledBlockScaleFp8ScaledMMKernel(Fp8BlockScaledMMLinearKernel):
+    """Block-scaled FP8 GEMM through AITER ``gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle``.
+
+    AITER #5141 dispatches ck, cktile, asm, opus, or FlyDSL from the tuned
+    row, including split-K when the kernel name carries it. This class only
+    prepares the shared contract: weights shuffled with ``layout=(16, 16)``
+    and K-major fp32 activation scales. It is selected when any probed M for
+    this ``(N, K)`` has a row, because one shuffled weight serves prefill and
+    decode.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config: FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config)
+        act_scale_descriptor = config.activation_quant_key.scale
+        # AITER indexes x_scale as kb * M + row (K-major). ROCm
+        # group_fp8_quant does not read column_major_scales, so
+        # apply_block_scaled_mm converts when the scale is still row-major.
+        self.quant_fp8 = QuantFP8(
+            static=act_scale_descriptor.static,
+            group_shape=act_scale_descriptor.group_shape,
+            num_token_padding=self.get_output_padding(),
+            use_ue8m0=False,
+            column_major_scales=True,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def is_supported(
+        cls, compute_capability: int | None = None
+    ) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+            return False, "requires ROCm."
+        if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_linear_enabled():
+            return (
+                False,
+                "requires setting `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` "
+                "and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR=1`.",
+            )
+        try:
+            import aiter  # noqa: F401
+        except Exception:
+            return False, "requires aiter library to be installed."
+        return True, None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def can_implement(
+        cls, config: FP8ScaledMMLinearLayerConfig
+    ) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
+        can_implement_base, reason = super().can_implement(config)
+        if not can_implement_base:
+            return can_implement_base, reason
+
+        act_quant_desc = config.activation_quant_key.scale
+        if act_quant_desc.group_shape != GroupShape(1, 128):
+            return (
+                False,
+                "Supports only dynamic per token group activation "
+                "quantization with group_shape=(1,128).",
+            )
+
+        if config.weight_shape is None:
+            return False, "weight_shape is required."
+        n, k = config.weight_shape
+
+        weight_group_shape = config.weight_quant_key.scale.group_shape
+        if weight_group_shape != GroupShape(128, 128):
+            return (
+                False,
+                f"requires weight_group_shape (128,128), "
+                f"got {weight_group_shape}.",
+            )
+
+        if not rocm_aiter_ops.is_blockscale_bpreshuffle_tuned(n, k):
+            return False, f"requires a tuned configuration for N={n}, K={k}."
+
+        return True, None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        super().process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+        params = FP8BlockParams.from_layer(layer)
+        if params.weight_scale_inv is not None:
+            ws, attr = params.weight_scale_inv, params.WEIGHT_SCALE_INV
+        else:
+            ws, attr = params.weight_scale, params.WEIGHT_SCALE
+        # gfx942 block-scale rows consume fp32 scales. e8m0 is widened once
+        # here; the GEMM entry point also widens, but the stored scale should
+        # already match the tuned kernels.
+        if ws is not None and ws.dtype == torch.float8_e8m0fnu:
+            replace_parameter(layer, attr, _upcast_e8m0_to_fp32(ws).contiguous())
+
+        w = FP8BlockParams.from_layer(layer).weight
+        replace_parameter(
+            layer,
+            FP8BlockParams.WEIGHT,
+            rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weight(w.data, layout=(16, 16)),
+        )
+
+    def apply_block_scaled_mm(
+        self,
+        A: torch.Tensor,
+        B: torch.Tensor,
+        As: torch.Tensor,
+        Bs: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if As.dtype != Bs.dtype:
+            if As.dtype == torch.float8_e8m0fnu:
+                As = _upcast_e8m0_to_fp32(As).contiguous()
+            else:
+                As = As.to(torch.float32)
+            Bs = Bs.to(torch.float32)
+
+        if As.dim() == 2 and As.size(-1) > 1 and As.stride(0) != 1:
+            As = As.t().contiguous().t()
+
+        return rocm_aiter_ops.gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle(
+            A, B, As, Bs, output_dtype=self.config.out_dtype
+        )
